The open bugs that involve users who cannot sign in despite entering the correct password are:

- BUG-2024: User cannot sign in on Firefox 130 despite entering the correct password; session times out after 6 seconds (Source: BUG-2024)
- BUG-2051: User cannot sign in on Firefox 130 despite entering the correct password; session times out after 27 seconds (Source: BUG-2051)
- BUG-2095: User cannot sign in on Firefox 130 despite entering the correct password; session times out after 19 seconds (Source: BUG-2095)
- BUG-2108: User cannot sign in on Edge 127 despite entering the correct password; session times out after 22 seconds (Source: BUG-2108)

Note: BUG-2024, BUG-2051, and BUG-2095 are explicitly described as involving users who cannot sign in despite entering the correct password. BUG-2108 is also relevant as it describes a similar issue on Edge 127. All these bugs are in the "Login" module and are marked as "Open" in status. (Source: BUG-2024, BUG-2051, BUG-2095, BUG-2108)

The bug report that describes cart item quantity resetting to 1 on Safari 17 when the quantity was set above 29 is BUG-2032.

(Source: BUG-2032)
